visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a light pink dress and a lavender cardigan, stands in a brightly lit kitchen holding a wedge of green cabbage. She gestures with her free hand while looking at the camera. (2) Multiple quick cuts show her face and the cabbage with a stylized '5 minutes' graphic overlay. (3) A close-up reveals a plate of cooked cabbage seasoned with garlic and chili flakes. (4) An animated sequence features a cartoon cat in a chef's hat cutting vegetables. (5) A pair of hands is shown chopping a cabbage wedge on a pink cutting board. (6) The chopped cabbage is placed into a white oval dish, where minced garlic is added with a spoon, oil is sprayed, and soy sauce and red chili powder are poured over it. (7) The dish is placed inside a microwave oven, a clear plastic lid is added, and the timer is set on the digital panel. (8) The woman reappears, holding the steaming dish and expressing delight. (9) She is then seen eating the cooked cabbage with wooden chopsticks. (10) The final shot shows an empty dish with remnants of sauce and garlic.
